visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Index Used Instead of Value
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In 3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6 5 3 the digit 1 appears twice, but the program reports every digit exactly once.

solution.explanation: The counter to increase is the one whose index equals the value read from the array. counts[i] counts positions, not values, so each position is counted once. counts[data[i]] counts the values themselves.
